asked.item: Is a 2-second clip long enough for a Facebook Reel
Posting the video as a Reel on a Facebook Page through Blotato

verdict.reason: The help pages state the Facebook Reel duration range, which directly answers whether a short clip meets it, and state that videos publish as Reels.

steps.text: Facebook Reel duration must be between 3 seconds and 4 hours, so a clip shorter than 3 seconds does not meet the Reel minimum.
Videos published through Blotato to Facebook always publish as Reels.
